status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction: AWS/Amazon Data Services' Madison County data-center campus remains supported by official state announcements, MDEQ construction stormwater coverage for the JAN 100 Site, and a Madison County Board of Supervisors utility-permit approval. A building-level certificate of occupancy, energization record, or live IT-load record was not located.

actions.government_body: Office of the Governor of Mississippi
actions.result_status: The Governor announced AWS’s planned $10 billion Madison County investment and a groundbreaking ceremony for multiple data-center complexes in two industrial parks.
actions.access_caveat: State groundbreaking announcement is not a building-permit register or proof that every announced building is complete or live.
actions.evidence_note: Groundbreaking is recorded as a state/company milestone, not as a local vote.

actions.government_body: Office of the Governor of Mississippi
actions.result_status: Mississippi announced Amazon’s planned $11 billion expansion of existing Madison County data-center operations and said the broader state plan totaled $25 billion; the announcement does not publish building-level permits or COs.
actions.access_caveat: State announcement is not a county/city approval, utility interconnection order, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: The $11 billion expansion is kept separate from the 2024 multi-campus construction announcement.

actions.result_status: Entergy stated its planned grid investments would support Amazon’s Madison County expansion; it did not publish a project-specific service agreement, interconnection order, or first-power record.
actions.access_caveat: Utility statement is not a commission order or proof of energized IT load.
actions.evidence_note: Utility support is labeled separately from county land-use and building approvals.

actions.result_status: MDEQ enSearch lists Amazon Data Services Inc / Gray Construction coverage MSR109367 for the JAN 100 Site in Madison County, with coverage beginning October 24, 2024, modified May 14, 2025, and expiring January 31, 2027.
actions.access_caveat: Construction stormwater coverage confirms regulated construction-site activity; it is not a building permit, certificate of occupancy, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: The active coverage and permit certificate support the site work-construction status for the Madison County Parkway / JAN 100 Site.

actions.result_status: MDEQ enSearch lists Amazon Data Services Inc / Yates-Turner coverage MSR109366 for the MCEDA Megasite as terminated on May 28, 2026.
actions.access_caveat: Coverage termination is a stormwater-permit status, not evidence that a data-center building was completed or energized.
actions.evidence_note: Kept as a permitting-status update because another JAN 100 Site construction stormwater coverage remains active.

actions.result_status: The Board approved Amazon Data Services, Inc.'s request for a utility permit for Madison County Parkway and Madison County Parkway East right of way, described in quick notes as utilities beneath Madison County Parkway right of way.
actions.access_caveat: County right-of-way utility approval is not a service energization record or proof of live IT load.
actions.evidence_note: The agenda identifies the item as an Amazon Data Services utility permit; the quick notes record approval.
